summary.he: דפדפן סטלת' שיתופי לאוטומציה ול-QA, עם לוח משותף למחשב של המשתמש ותצוגה חיה
summary.en: Shared stealth browser for automation and QA, with a shared clipboard and a live view

connection_providers.title: Facebook login — the office browser signs in with this
connection_providers.title_he: כניסה לפייסבוק — הדפדפן של הלשכה מתחבר עם זה
connection_providers.now: Type the account ONCE, here — user + password. `bbox b42 task login <slug> facebook` then leases it from the credential plane under the task runner's own container identity, types it into the page over CDP and never prints, journals or returns it: the agent that drives the browser says which SITE, never which secret. Because it is re-derived at every login, it survives a container recreate, an image rebuild and a profile wipe — the three events that used to cost the owner a re-login. Companion keys: BROWSER42_LOGIN_FACEBOOK_USER (the email/phone) and an optional BROWSER42_LOGIN_FACEBOOK_URL. The lease is granted only to the `browser42-task-runner` service, which is what the `service` field on this app's connections[] entry pins down.
connection_providers.wizard: fill שם משתמש + סיסמה once; then sign in from the browser task: bbox b42 task login <slug> facebook

connection_providers.title: Facebook one-time code (TOTP) — the office browser passes the second step by itself
connection_providers.title_he: קוד חד-פעמי לפייסבוק (TOTP) — הדפדפן של הלשכה עובר את השלב השני לבד
connection_providers.now: The second step of the Facebook sign-in, passed by the office itself. Paste the TOTP secret ONCE — the otpauth:// URI an authenticator exports, or the base32 key Facebook shows under «אימות דו-שלבי → אפליקציית אימות»; connections validates it on write (RFC 6238, totp.py) and keeps it in the vault only — export and lease skip the kind, so no container ever holds it. When the login page asks for a code, `bbox b42 task login <slug> facebook` asks the plane for the CURRENT code (GET /api/totp/browser42-totp-facebook, gated to the `browser42-task-runner` service this entry names) and types it: no agent, log, journal or response carries the secret or the code. Without this row the login stops with a NAMED refusal (`needs_totp_secret`) that carries the handoff link to the live view, where a human finishes the step.
connection_providers.wizard: סוד ה-TOTP מתוך «אימות דו-שלבי → אפליקציית אימות» — paste the otpauth:// URI or the base32 key once; from then on the browser passes the second step by itself
